test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Stories of dolphins’ saving human lives ________ throughout history.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**have been told**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence is in the present perfect tense, indicating that the action started in the past and continues up to the present.
 
• Structure: 
 
• "Have been told" is the correct form of the present perfect tense for the third person plural subject "stories".
 
• The use of "throughout history" also suggests that this action has been ongoing.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

**Complete sentence**: "Stories of dolphins’ saving human lives have been told__ throughout history."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 

"**Have been said**" is grammatically correct but less commonly used in this context.

"**Told**" is in the past tense and does not fit with the present perfect tense of the sentence.

"**Had been said**" is in the past perfect tense and does not fit with the present perfect tense of the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• "Told" is used here because it implies the act of narrating or recounting stories.
 
• "Said," on the other hand, is more typically used for direct speech or when you want to attribute specific words to a person.
 
• Therefore, "told" is the preferred verb because it relates to the act of narrating stories.
